title: Gastô NFC-e receipt export
description: The JSON format written by Gastô when exporting an imported NFC-e receipt.

accessKey.description: The access key identifying the receipt in the tax authority.

url.description: The receipt portal URL requested by the importer.

receipt.description: The receipt data parsed from the portal response.

issuedAt.description: The issuance instant in the issuer's time zone, when the issuance details can be resolved.

municipalityCode.description: The seven-digit IBGE code of the issuer's municipality, when the issuance details can be resolved.

$schema.description: The public JSON Schema URL for this receipt export.

merchant.description: The issuing merchant's details, if present.

items.description: The purchased items in receipt order.

totals.description: The totals reported by the receipt, if it has a totals section.

payments.description: The payment entries in receipt order. Empty when no entries could be read.

metadata.description: The receipt's issuance and authorization details, if present.

name.description: The merchant's legal name as shown on the receipt.

cnpj.description: The merchant's Brazilian business tax identifier as shown on the receipt.

address.description: The merchant's physical address shown on the receipt, if present.

id.description: The zero-based position of the item row on the source document.

name.description: The product description shown on the receipt.

code.description: The product code shown on the receipt, if present.

quantity.description: The quantity as text, preserving the receipt's decimal formatting.

unit.description: The unit of measure of the product, if present.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit in BRL, which may include fractions of a cent.

lineTotal.description: The total amount for this line in BRL as reported on the receipt.

itemCount.description: The reported number of line items.

grossTotal.description: The gross amount reported before any applied discounts.

totalDiscounts.description: The total discounts applied to the receipt.

totalDue.description: The final amount reported as payable on the receipt.

totalTaxes.description: The total incident taxes reported on the receipt.

id.description: The zero-based position of the payment row on the source document.

method.description: The payment method label as shown on the receipt.

amount.description: The amount reported as paid with this payment method, in BRL.

number.description: The fiscal document number as reported by the portal.

series.description: The fiscal document series as reported by the portal.

issuingDateTime.description: The issuance date and time as text in `dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss` format.

authorizationProtocol.description: The authorization protocol number assigned by the tax authority.

authorizationDateTime.description: The authorization date and time as text in `dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss` format.

environment.description: The tax authority environment, if recognized.
